summary: Comprehensive testing of JasprChain L1 blockchain after tokenomics update. All 36 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend fully functional with JASPR branding, testnet badge, and all pages working correctly. Token changed from JSP to JASPR, wallet allocation changed from 1,000 to 10,000 JASPR.
passed_tests: Backend API Tests (36/36 passed):
- Health endpoint returns chain_id=1, status=healthy, network=testnet
- Network stats shows 4 validators, TPS, finality metrics, network=testnet
- TPS endpoint returns target_tps=10000
- Tokenomics endpoint returns correct litepaper values:
- Total supply: 1,000,000,000 JASPR (1B with 9 decimals)
- Distribution: 52% community, 15% treasury, 10% liquidity, 10% team, 8% investors, 5% ecosystem
- Token symbol: JASPR
- Inflation: fixed_supply
- Treasury addresses properly initialized (jaspr1treasury_*)
- Circulating supply increases when wallets created
- Get all validators returns 4 validators (Jaspr Labs, Foundation, Community, Ecosystem)
- Get single validator by address works
- Non-existent validator returns 404
- Staking validators endpoint returns APY for each validator (~9.5%)
- Staking stats overview shows total_staked, average_apy, unbonding_period=14 days
- Stake tokens to validator works
- Unstake tokens from validator works
- Stake with insufficient balance returns 400
- Unstake with insufficient stake returns 400
- Dynamic APY calculation working (varies by validator)
- Create MPC wallet returns address, public_key, threshold=2-of-3
- New wallets receive 10,000 JASPR from community pool
- Get wallet details shows balance, AA wallet info, stakes
- Get wallet balance shows 10,000 JASPR initial balance
- Get blocks list works
- Get genesis block (height=0) works
- Non-existent block returns 404
- Sentinel status shows guard_mode=enforced
- Sentinel stats shows total_scanned, threats_detected
- Sentinel quarantine endpoint works
- Set sentinel mode works (passive/warning/enforced)
- Mempool stats shows pending, by_lane, total_gas
- Transfer transaction creates pending tx
- Token symbol shows JASPR (not JSP or JJ) throughout
- Full staking flow: create wallet -> stake -> verify -> unstake -> verify
Frontend Tests (All Passed):
- Dashboard loads with JASPR branding, TESTNET badge, network stats
- Sidebar shows 'JASPR' and 'TESTNET V0.1'
- 'Testnet Connected' status shown at bottom
- Validators show stake in JASPR (12K, 8K, 6K, 4K)
- Staking page shows 4 validators with APY (9.53-9.59%)
- 'CORE L1 FEATURE' badge on staking page
- Validator selection shows stake form with estimated APY
- Stake/Unstake buttons work correctly
- Amount input accepts JASPR values
- Wallet creation works (MPC Protected badge visible)
- Wallet shows 10,000.0000 JASPR balance
- Send form with recipient and amount inputs
- Account Abstraction section shows session keys, guardians, 2FA
- Block Explorer shows blocks list with height, hash, proposer, txns
- Validators page shows all 4 validators with stake in JASPR
- AI Sentinel page shows guard mode selector (ENFORCED badge)
- Mempool page shows pending txs, lane distribution
- Navigation between all pages works correctly
- End-to-end staking flow: Create wallet -> Navigate to staking -> Select validator -> Stake 100 JASPR -> Success message shown -> Active stakes displayed
